race.comment: TERRALIGHT (5) is racing well this time in, winning a couple in a row earlier in the campaign, just missing last time over this route in a very similar race. She sets up for a lovely run just behind the pace from the barrier and should go close. DUBAI DANCER (1) can mix her form, struggling last time in town. She absolutely loves racing here at home with 4 wins from 9 starts, including 2/4 over this route. Drawn wide but she's got the pace to cross and will take catching. BUDJIK BOY (2) comes back in trip off a let-up, having struggled his past couple. His best is good enough to figure. JUSTIBELLA (7) is coming off a maiden win at Ballarat Synthetic. She'd handled heavy ground prior and can go on with it. BREAK THE TABOO (6) is racing quite consistently of late and looks a solid chance again.
